"Game Title: VAHŞİ
Engine @COMMENT_BODY@ Visual Style: 3D Cel-shaded graphics, Telltale Games / The Walking Dead art style. Optimized for mobile devices (smooth performance). Atmospheric, dark, and gritty post-apocalyptic tone.

Main Menu UI Design:
- Background: A still, atmospheric 3D shot of a ruined 2360 city skyline at dusk, with flickering emergency lights and subtle wind movement.
- Music: Low, ambient drone with a melancholic low guitar melody.
- Menu Options:
  1. Oyuna Başla (New Game)
  2. Bölüm Seç (Chapters)
  3. Ayarlar (Settings)
  4. Çıkış (Quit)

--------------------------------------------------
GAME LORE @COMMENT_BODY@ BACKGROUND (Geçmiş ve Dünya)
--------------------------------------------------
- Setting: Year 2360, exactly 2 years after a global genetic catastrophe. 
- The Collapse: Two years ago, a genetic engineering accident triggered a catastrophic outbreak. Superpower nations and militaries tried to eradicate it by bombing cities, and AI systems attempted harsh quarantines, but everything ultimately failed.
- Current World: Civilization collapsed. Buildings and partial technologies remain, but nature and ruins dominate. 

--------------------------------------------------
THE THREAT: 'THE SAVAGES' (Düşmanlar)
--------------------------------------------------
- Nature: Humans infected by the mutated virus. They do not rot completely and remain visually distinguishable from regular humans, but they have completely lost their intellect, reason, and moral values. They act like parasites and hunt/consume human flesh.
- Transmission: Transmission via airborne vectors is gone. It is now strictly transmitted through bites (blood contact) or consuming contaminated food and water.
- Survival Mechanic: Contaminated food or water emits a faint sweet-metallic odor and registers high radiation levels on Geiger counters, allowing the characters to detect poisoned supplies.

--------------------------------------------------
PROTAGONISTS (Karakterler)
--------------------------------------------------
- Main Character: 18-year-old male, highly intelligent, strategic, and resourceful survivor. Heterosexual (will have a love interest later in the story). Appearance: Brown hair, green eyes, 182 cm tall, athletic build.
- Brother/Companion: Not a biological twin, but identical in appearance (182 cm, brown hair, green eyes, very similar face). Starts the journey side-by-side with the protagonist, but as the crew and camp grow, their roles diverge and they will take separate paths while maintaining a close bond.

--------------------------------------------------
OPENING SCENE / PROLOGUE (İlk Sahne ve Başlangıç)
--------------------------------------------------
- Location: An underground shelter beneath an old ruined gas station. 
- Situation: The brothers are evaluating their last remaining supplies. A water canteen is tested with a Geiger counter and checked for smell, revealing high radiation and a sweet-metallic odor. The protagonist throws the poisoned water away.
- Inciting Incident: Right after, a 'Savage' approaches the shelter door, making low, primitive, unnatural sounds, trying to get in.
- First Player Choice: 
  [A] Stay silent, hide, and barricade the door with heavy items to wait it out.
  [B] Set up an aggressive ambush right by the door to fight and eliminate it.
  [C] Escape quietly through the back ventilation tunnel to avoid a confrontation.
"
